title: Deeper/broader source-lineage and declared-capability screen
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Screen newly surfaced open-source CAD/viewer projects for genuinely independent DWG, DXF, or ACIS implementation routes
Trace application claims to package manifests, parser dependencies, and explicit feature matrices
Refine optional comparator guidance without expanding the per-slice validation loop

method.kind: Read primary project README, package manifest, dependency lock references, licensing notes, and explicit format-support table
method.limitations: Mutable project pages were reviewed on 2026-10-18. No source audit or execution was performed for cadview's DXF parser; all capability conclusions are limited to documented route/dependency claims. No peer or native application result is asserted.

sources.observed: The README describes a 13-entity DXF parser/viewer with a Canvas 2D renderer. Its optional @cadview/dwg package is explicitly LibreDWG compiled to WebAssembly under GPL-3.0. No core DXF parser source audit or precise unsupported-field study was performed.

The project describes itself as 2D CAD and a DWG viewer. Its cadview-core manifest depends on acadrust = 0.3 and its lockfile resolves ACadRust 0.3.4. It is an ACadRust-lineage application route, not an independent DWG parser or 3D-solid witness.

The README's broad compatibility prose names ACIS, but the explicit ACIS SAT/SAB row marks both read and write unavailable. The project is not an eligible ACIS comparator based on its own current support matrix.

The documented default DWG path uses LibreDWG. The alternative parser is distributed as a private package subject to authorization/licensing. Project documentation describes partial 3DSOLID/SAB extraction and best-effort wireframe or bounding-box fallback, without full B-rep tessellation.

The project describes an experimental bare SAT/SAB parser and a limited, producer/save-version-dependent conversion profile. It is an inner-stream route and does not decode DWG sections or establish entity-owner-AcDs associations.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies optional route classification and lineage deduplication: cadview DWG is LibreDWG-lineage, CodeCAD is ACadRust-lineage, CADKernel's current ACIS matrix is unavailable, proprietary MLightCAD is not an open-source route, and cq-acis remains an experimental bare-stream comparator only. No new required gate or implementation work was added.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not add any screened project as a routine peer dependency, CMake target, CI job, fixture, or per-slice validation prerequisite.
Use a screened viewer only for a named projection question after pinning the exact source/dependency route and auditing its parser boundary.
Deduplicate evidence by the implementation that parses the bytes, not by application count or renderer diversity.
Treat marketed format matrices as discovery leads only; require executable implementation and independent expected-value evidence before promoting a capability.
Keep cq-acis limited to an exactly matched bare SAT/SAB profile; it does not establish DWG section extraction, owner/AcDs association, or native CAD acceptance.
Keep findings 130/73 and J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; no support claim changed.
